senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) span (the spread fingers); distance from the little finger to the thumb of a spread hand.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 5b:1">Keth. 5ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 11a:5">Men. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>זו ז׳</he> this one (the little finger) is used for measuring the span.
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 12 ז׳ אמורה וכ׳ zereth mentioned therein (in measures), is half a cubit of six handbreadths; a. fr.—Du. זֵרָתַיִים, זֵירָ׳.

<cite ref="Menachot 85a:10">Men. 85ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 9:3">Tosef. ib. IX, 3</cite> <he>קנה זרת ושבולת ז׳</he> the halm one span long, and the ear two; <cite ref="Taanit 5a:8">Taan. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>יֵרָתַיִם</he>.
